description: A single, floor-length curtain, rendered in a vibrant teal color. The fabric is depicted with deep, vertical pleats, suggesting a gathered or pleated heading. The curtain drapes naturally, with subtle folds and waves that give it a sense of volume and texture. The bottom edge exhibits a soft, undulating hemline, indicating the fluidity of the material. The overall presentation is clean and minimalist, focusing solely on the form and color of the curtain against a neutral gray background. This design suggests a modern aesthetic, suitable for a variety of interior design schemes.
